title: It sees what’s in its way.
detail: Proximity sensors stop the roll before contact.

keys.label: Over the desk's shoulder: the dog ahead
Cut: three-quarter, the desk drives at the dog, rings on the floor
Floor level, side on: it stops short, amber
Front three-quarter: stopped safely, into the fade
